newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine weekly official crop progress.
newsitem.headline: Argentine weekly official crop progress.

text.p: Argentine farmers have begun sowing their first long-cycle 1997/97 wheat in Buenos Aires, Cordoba, Entre Rios and Santa Fe, the Agriculture Secretariat said in June 6 weekly crop report Thursday.

But insufficient soil moisture in Cordoba, Santa Fe and Entre Rios is likely to cause problems for wheat sowing in those areas. The key province of Buenos Aires received good rain in the week to June 6. Cotton harvesting progressed slowly and finished the week 71.9 percent complete. Maize harvesting was 91.2 percent complete.
